proposed.explanation: The controlling PD 1096 source is Rule III Sections 308 and 309. Section 308 covers licensed full-time inspection, the jobsite logbook, and the Certificate of Completion. Section 309 covers the Certificate of Occupancy application package, BFP final inspection/FSIC step, final OBO review, fee payment before issuance, partial occupancy, and later certificates for changes in use.
